categories.title: Storage & Shelving
categories.blurb: Shelves, cabinets, chests, sideboards, display and filing cabinets.

categories.title: Wardrobes
categories.blurb: Full-height wardrobes with hinged or sliding doors, rails and baskets.

categories.title: Seating
categories.blurb: Chairs, stools and armchairs with lifts, swivels and reclining backs.

categories.title: Tables & Desks
categories.blurb: Desks and tables with height adjustment, drawers, cable flaps and tilting tops.

categories.title: Room Dividers

categories.title: Kitchen & Appliances
categories.blurb: Kitchen runs, corner kitchens, islands, cabinets and bins, plus laundry, dishwashing, cooling, cooking and countertop appliances.

categories.title: Tools & Workshop
categories.blurb: Power tools and workshop machines: drills, saws, grinders, vacuums, compressors and pumps, plus welding, soldering, joining and adhesive equipment.

categories.title: Containers & Boxes
categories.blurb: Lidded and folding crates, mesh pallet boxes, drums and walk-in storage containers.

categories.title: Material Handling
categories.blurb: Pallet trucks, tipping skips and other equipment for moving loads around a warehouse.

categories.title: Ladders & Steps
categories.blurb: Mobile platform steps for reaching upper shelf levels safely.

categories.title: Hazardous Materials Storage
